title: Our Work: Marketing Case Studies | Vertical Studios
description: See the marketing we run for the companies of Vertical Life: ad campaigns, conversion tracking, video, HighLevel systems and click-to-edit websites.

blocks.headline: Work we run every day
blocks.body: Studios lives inside Vertical Life. We run marketing for its companies with the same senior leads, apprentice crew and process you'd get. Here's the work, company by company.

blocks.heading: Vertical Life
blocks.body:
**Coworking and ecosystem**

The challenge: help people searching for coworking find the Atrium. Then show the team what's working, on a website they can edit themselves.

What we did:
bullets: Brand and coworking search campaigns for the Atrium on Google Ads
Conversion tracking in Google Tag Manager and GA4
Event templates and branding inside HighLevel
A new website built on Astro, with a click-to-edit editor (TinaCMS)
Atrium packages and prices, meeting room credits and a visit form, all on the site

blocks.heading: Vertical Immersive
blocks.body:
**Higher education**

The challenge: get open houses in front of 15 to 18 year olds. Then make sure every RSVP lands where the team can follow up.

What we did:
bullets: Meta ads for open houses, aimed at 15 to 18 year olds
Facebook lead forms connected to HighLevel, so every RSVP lands in the pipeline
Awareness campaigns and Google display ads
A cold email campaign, with mailed follow-up to non-responders

blocks.heading: Vertical Wealth
blocks.body:
**Financial planning**

The challenge: market a financial firm with clarity while staying compliant. And give the team a plan they can run week after week.

What we did:
bullets: A campaign playbook with five client personas and a phased plan
Content rules that keep a financial firm's marketing compliant
The weekly email series, relaunched as Weekly Lessons

blocks.heading: More case studies on the way
blocks.body:
We also serve businesses and nonprofits across Indiana and beyond. Their stories are theirs to tell, so we ask first.

Outside client case studies are added here as clients approve them.
